bass.tags: Industrial techno with heavy distortion and mechanical textures. A distorted kick drum with a long, saturated sub-tail drives the rhythm at 130 BPM in the key of F minor. A metallic, percussive synth sequence plays a repetitive sixteenth-note pattern with a resonant filter sweep. High-frequency white noise bursts and bit-crushed industrial clangs occur on every second and fourth beat. A low-frequency sawtooth bass drone oscillates with a slow LFO on the cutoff frequency. The track features a dense, claustrophobic mix with heavy compression and short room reverb on the percussion elements. A high-pitched, dissonant sine wave lead enters with a portamento effect, sliding between semitones.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted kick drum with sub-tail, metallic sixteenth-note synth sequence]

[Section A]
[bit-crushed industrial clangs on beats 2 and 4, white noise bursts]
[low-frequency sawtooth bass drone with LFO modulation]

[Section B]
[dissonant sine wave lead with portamento enters]
[resonant filter sweep on percussive synth]

drums.tags: Industrial rock with heavy electronic elements. A distorted, overdriven electric guitar plays a repetitive, syncopated two-note riff. The drum machine features a dry, compressed snare and a punchy kick drum with a steady eighth-note hi-hat pattern. A gritty, monophonic synth bass follows the guitar riff. The tempo is 100 BPM in the key of D minor. The production is characterized by high-gain distortion on the melodic instruments and a dry, close-mic aesthetic on the percussion.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar riff, dry drum machine kick and snare]

[Main Section]
[gritty synth bass enters, eighth-note hi-hats]
[syncopated two-note guitar pattern continues]

vocals.tags: Deep House with a focus on atmospheric textures and rhythmic syncopation. A muted, sub-heavy kick drum drives the rhythm at 124 BPM in the key of G minor. A percussive, wooden-sounding synth pluck plays a syncopated 16th-note pattern with a short decay and moderate delay. A low-pass filtered sawtooth bassline follows the kick on the off-beats. Shakers and a crisp open hi-hat emphasize the upbeat. A lush, wide-panned polyphonic synth pad enters with long attack and release times, using a slow filter sweep to create movement. A secondary FM synth lead provides occasional staccato accents with a high-frequency resonance. The track maintains a steady 4/4 time signature throughout. Reverb is applied sparingly to the percussion but heavily to the pads to create depth.
vocals.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[muted sub-kick, syncopated wooden synth pluck]
[shakers enter]

[Main Section]
[low-pass filtered sawtooth bassline enters]
[open hi-hat on the upbeat]
[lush polyphonic synth pad with slow filter sweep]

[Breakdown]
[kick and bass drop out]
[FM synth lead accents with high resonance]
[pad swells in volume]

[Outro]
[kick and bass return]
[instruments layer out one by one until only the synth pluck remains]
